regions.purpose: The full-screen map canvas — a pin for every Collection Entry in every visible Collection. Panning and zooming move the viewport.
Overlay holding entry to the Collection list and to Settings.
The map's search field — typing resolves Location candidates from the active provider, and the results are pickable.
A horizontally scrollable row of chips, one per Collection, controlling which Collections' pins show on the map and jumping the camera to a Collection.
Holds the drop-a-pin affordance, which starts the Location-first flow.
